newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 97,750 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 45.064 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 41,500 tonnes, in Germany 18,750, in the U.K. 16,500, in Belgium 10,000, in the Netherlands 6,000 and in Denmark 5,000 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy for the current season whites campaign for licences to end-March to be between 45.060 and 45.064 Ecus per 100 kilos.
Traders had also forecast the total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be between 60,000 and 100,000 tonnes versus 79,500 last week when the restitution was 44.709 Ecus.
